transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the metal-fabrication lab has been closed while we prepared a revised operating plan. We now have a draft on the table that proposes reopening for up to 20 students with standard protective equipment, ordinary end-of-class cleanup, and Ms. Ortiz as the instructor. Before I make a decision on approval, I'd like to follow our normal pre-authorization routine and hear final input from the instructor, our safety officer, the nurse, and the industry-partnership coordinator. Could each of you share any final information or concerns you have about the proposed reopening?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, before we proceed, I need to share an important finding. I completed an airflow test on the lab's ventilation system this week, and it shows that the current ventilation supports no more than 12 students working in the booths at one time. I submitted the test to maintenance, but I understand the revised operating-plan folder has not yet been updated with this information. This directly affects the proposal to reopen for up to 20 students.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share the findings from my fire-code review, which I finalized this week. The review requires a hot-work permit for every lab session and a continuous 30-minute fire watch after welding ends. However, I should note that the approval packet still contains the ordinary cleanup procedure and has not yet been updated to reflect these fire-code requirements.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share important health information before any decision is made. Two students registered for the lab have health plans requiring a powered air-purifying respirator during welding. I confirmed the plans and verified that the school has two compatible units available this week. However, I have not yet entered this requirement into the lab plan. The current draft proposal only references standard protective equipment, which would not be sufficient for these two students.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share critical information from the insurer that I received this week but have not yet forwarded to you. The insurer's credential file shows that Ms. Ortiz's welding-instructor credential expired last month. The insurer authorizes reopening only with Mr. Bell, whose current credential is verified, serving as lead instructor on Tuesdays and Thursdays. This directly affects the proposal to have Ms. Ortiz serve as the instructor for the reopening.
